# Vojislav Miloradovic - Machine-Readable Credentials Archive

> **Last Generated:** 2026-09-23 03:24 UTC
> Curated, structured, and token-optimized record of professional certifications, badges, and learning achievements across Microsoft Learn, AWS, Google Cloud, Credly, LinkedIn, and Google Developer.

## Portfolio Overview & Total Counts
- **Microsoft Learn**: 35,951 completed units | 4,842 total achievements | 6,043,525 XP
- **Google Cloud Skills**: 395 badges
- **AWS Skill Builder**: 899 completed courses/activities
- **Credly**: 681 credentials
- **LinkedIn**: 1,669 verified external certifications
- **Google Developer**: 172 milestone badges | 1,647 codelabs & activities
